originalEvidence.claim: After the offshore duty-free policy expansion, Hainan duty-free daily sales exceeded RMB120m and were more than 2x YoY; 2020 actual sales exceeded RMB32bn.
2020Q3 alone revenue RMB15.829bn +38.97% YoY and attributable profit RMB2.234bn +141.90%; 1-9M operating cash flow +76.66%.

events.riskNotes: New duty-free operators/stores increased competitive supply; selected stock itself already had +15.1% 20d and +27.9% 60d excess before the checkpoint.

events.mappingNotes: Initial power-sector carbon allocation and low early prices do not establish a clean listed-company long benefit.
The primary direct effect is destructive to tutoring economics; no independent positive A-share beneficiary is established.
Revenue incidence differs by title/user mix, but the event does not by itself create a fresh positive A-share earnings bridge.
Potential state-owned share gain is speculative at the checkpoint; no clean positive company earnings reset is proven.
Large price cuts could be offset by winner volume/share, but no cutoff-valid selected-company net-profit bridge is frozen.
